# Censorship Alpha
> When countries block crypto exchanges, where does the money go?

Correlates real-time internet censorship data (Voidly) with on-chain
blockchain fund flows (Nansen). Generates interactive HTML reports
showing which countries block which exchanges and how smart money
responds on-chain.

## Usage
python3 censorship_alpha.py [--output path.html] [--png] [--json]

## Flags
- --png: Export charts as PNG images for social media
- --json: Export raw correlation data as structured JSON
- --output: Specify output HTML path (default: output/report.html)

## Data Sources
- Voidly API (https://api.voidly.ai) — exchange accessibility checks,
  country risk tiers, ISP blocking data, 7-day shutdown forecasts,
  censorship incidents. Public endpoints, no auth required.
- Nansen CLI (npm i -g nansen-cli) — smart money net flows, DEX trades,
  token screener, wallet profiler, prediction markets. Requires API key.
- Ground-truth: Chainalysis 2026, CoinGecko, Cloudwards regulatory data.

## Monitored Exchanges (8)
binance.com, coinbase.com, kraken.com, kucoin.com, okx.com, bybit.com,
gate.io, crypto.com

## Countries Analyzed (15)
Iran, China, Russia, Turkey, Nigeria, Pakistan, Egypt, Vietnam, India,
Saudi Arabia, UAE, Thailand, Myanmar, Belarus, Venezuela

## Chains Tracked (4)
Ethereum, BNB Chain, Solana, Base

## Output Files
- output/report.html — Interactive HTML report with Plotly charts
- output/data.json — Structured JSON for programmatic access
- output/heatmap.png — Exchange blocking heat map
- output/flows.png — Smart money flow trends (24h/7d/30d)
- output/impact.png — Censorship impact score ranking
- output/correlation.png — Censorship vs impact scatter plot

## For AI Agents (MCP)
Access Voidly censorship data via MCP server:
  npx @voidly/mcp-server
Tools: check_service_accessibility, get_platform_risk, get_isp_risk_index,
       get_risk_forecast, get_active_incidents

## Install
pip install requests plotly jinja2 kaleido
npm i -g nansen-cli
nansen login --api-key YOUR_KEY
